doc.title: Joe LaBarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 15, 2021

title: Most unusual gig: butter knives with the Tonight Show band
summary: With Tony Bennett at a Friars Club Roast he subbed for Ed Shaughnessy and played with butter knives.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Okay we’ll wrap up shortly. The guy at the cocktail party —
Wait a minute, where’s my drink if I’ve got to talk to that guy?
He says, “What’s the worst gig you ever played?”

The worst gig I ever played. Oh it was probably some club date that you know was just so aggravating from start to finish. Nothing really comes to mind, Monk. I could tell you the most unusual gig that I ever played.

When I was with Tony Bennett we were scheduled to appear at a Friar’s Club Roast here in Los Angeles. And we were on with Doc Severinsen’s Tonight Show band so Eddie Shaughnessy, you know and all the cats and us. Well around four o’clock that afternoon,

tragically, Ed Shaughnessy’s younger son was killed in a car accident. So Ed of course was not going to be available. So they come looking for me at the last minute to go in and play with the Tonight Show band, which I was more than willing to do. But we couldn’t find Tony Bennett’s road manager. He had disappeared. And he had my cymbals and my stick bag. And Eddie, like any drummer would do, had his cymbals and his stick bag with him. So the only thing that was on the stage was Ed’s drumset, which is massive, and hi- hat cymbals. So I ended up playing with the Tonight Show band for about thirty minutes, maybe forty minutes with two butter knives and I’m trying very carefully to not break the heads, with these two butter knives, playing along with the band while we do our little set. And then fortunately, by the time it was Tony’s set we tracked down the road manager and we got my cymbals and my sticks. But here’s — I’m playing behind Conte Candoli and Snooky Young you know and Pete Christlieb, but I’ve got two butter knives in my hands.
I can just see, what happens when you’re playing a ballad? No Joe, brushes, we want brushes.
Good luck. I don’t know what I did, honestly, Monk, it’s a long time ago. But that’s the oddest thing that’s ever happened to me.
